video._divergent_pictureInPicture: en:d55e9e — it, pt-BR and pt-PT keep the English because Apple does; the other 17 use their own name for the macOS feature, measured from the shipping loctables. Naming a system feature something the user's own Mac does not call it is the defect, so matching English here is the fix, not a gap. See .claude/agents/i18n-review.md §6b.

welcome._divergent_aiSetup: en:7013af — English keeps the noun; the 20 locales take a verb (ca Configura, de Konfigurieren, fi Ota käyttöön, ru Настроить). Part of speech follows each language's UI convention, not English's: a link that performs the action takes a verb there, and Apple's noun forms read as section titles. Deliberate — see 89b11f5a and the call-site comment in WelcomeHomeView.swift.

privacy.redactionIntro: PII redaction is opt-in. It’s off by default because false positives (redacting research-relevant text) damage data accuracy. The feature uses Microsoft Presidio, an open-source text scanner, with a configurable confidence threshold (default 0.7).
privacy.actionThreshold: For sensitive data, lower the confidence threshold (try 0.5) to catch more at the cost of more false positives.

aiConsent.title: AI-Powered Analysis
aiConsent.intro: Bristlenose uses AI to analyse your interview transcripts. When you use a cloud provider, transcript data is sent to that provider's servers for processing.
aiConsent.notUsedForTraining: Your data is not used to train AI models. See each provider's terms for their data retention policies.
aiConsent.sentToCloudLabel: Sent to your chosen cloud provider
aiConsent.sentItem1: Processed interview transcripts (with PII redaction applied first, if enabled)
aiConsent.sentItem3: Analysis requests (topic segmentation, quote extraction, theme clustering)
aiConsent.sentSummary: Data sent to cloud provider: processed transcripts, speaker codes, and analysis requests
aiConsent.agentAccess: If you turn on Agent Access for a project, the quotes an agent reads — and, unless Anonymise is on, the participant names beside them, along with your edits and tags — are sent to that agent's provider each time you ask it a question. A separate company, under its own terms. Off by default, and set per project.
aiConsent.localItem2: Participant names, contact info, and personal details — unless you turn on Agent Access
aiConsent.localItem3: Your edits, tags, and report customisations — unless you turn on Agent Access
aiConsent.localSummary: Data that stays on your device: recordings, personal details, and your edits
aiConsent.providersIntro: Cloud providers that may process your data:
aiConsent.researcherResponsibility: Inform participants their interview data may be processed by third-party AI services, as required.
